statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Samoa International Financial Authority (SIFA) International Company Registry — e-SIFA name reservation portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Samoa has Samoan and English as official languages. The proposed International Company name may be registered in English or Samoan. If the name is in a non-Latin or non-official script, an approved English transliteration and an English meaning are required. The Registrar may decline a name whose meaning in Samoan is offensive, misleading, contrary to public policy, or that suggests a connection to the Government of Samoa or a foreign government.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon a name rejection, the applicant through the licensed SIFA agent may file a written administrative appeal to the Registrar of International Companies within 14 working days of the rejection notice. The appeal must set out statutory compliance, proposed structural disclaimer where applicable, and supporting legal arguments. If the Registrar rejects the appeal, a further appeal may be made to the Minister of Commerce, Industry and Labour within 30 days of the Registrar's decision. The reserved name cannot be extended except by re-filing a fresh reservation application before expiry and re-payment of the reservation fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office is not acceptable as the statutory registered office for an International Company. The International Companies Act 1987 requires a physical Samoan registered office maintained by a licensed international company services provider. Remote management and operational control over the bonded truck fleet abroad are permitted, but the legal registered office and agent in Samoa must have a real physical address capable of accepting service of process.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Approximately 10% annual probability of a SIFA unannounced inspection of the licensed agent's registered office address; approximately 65% annual probability of an unannounced Samoa Customs and Revenue Authority inspection of the physical receival or bonded cargo site in the airport feeder trucking operation, given customs-bonded controls and cargo security requirements.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1987 (Samoa), ss. 4-8 (incorporation), s. 25 (registered office and registered agent); International Companies Regulations 1988, regs. 3 and 7.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA), Apia
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form 1 - Application for Incorporation of an International Company, together with Memorandum and Articles of Association
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital under the International Companies Act 1987; the company may issue shares for such consideration as the directors determine, and no escrow account requirement applies.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the subscription of the initial ordinary shares be accepted, that the consideration recorded in the register of members be approved, and that share certificates be issued accordingly. RESOLVED FURTHER that the registered office of the Company be fixed at the offices of the Samoa International Finance Authority, Apia, Samoa, and the licensed registered agent be retained. RESOLVED FURTHER that [Name] be appointed first director, [Name] be appointed company secretary, and [Name] be appointed customs bonded operations manager. RESOLVED FURTHER that the officers be authorized to execute all incorporation filings, open bank accounts, obtain the bonded trucking license, and take all ancillary actions required to commence lawful business.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: SIFA Companies Registry (online and physical counter), Samoa International Finance Authority
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit two proposed company names on the prescribed reservation form; search the Samoa International Companies name index for identical or confusingly similar names; pay the name reservation fee; receive a Certificate of Name Reservation valid for 90 days; use the approved name in all incorporation documents.
required_dossiers: Name search authorization letter from the licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused because it is prohibited or confusingly similar, submit a newly proposed name within the reservation window; a written appeal may be made to the Registrar with a revised name; no filing fee refund is available.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Legal Practitioner / Notary Public, Samoa Law Society
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association in English; state the authorized share capital, registered agent appointment, and officer powers; all subscribers must sign before a notary; obtain consents from the first director and secretary to act.
required_dossiers: Consent to Act as Director (Form D)
Consent to Act as Secretary (Form S)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a document is rejected for a notarial or drafting irregularity, correct the signature block, re-notarize, and re-submit to SIFA; the original name reservation remains valid.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Incorporation Application and Payment of Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa International Finance Authority
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit Form 1 together with the signed Memorandum and Articles of Association, officer consents, registered agent appointment, and name reservation certificate; pay the USD 200 official filing fee by SIFA-approved bank draft or online payment; SIFA may issue a requisition if the dossier is incomplete.
required_dossiers: Bank draft or payment receipt for filing fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to any SIFA requisition letter within 30 days by filing the missing or corrected document; if the application lapses, resubmit with a fresh filing fee and no penalty if the name reservation is still valid.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Receipt of Certificate of Incorporation and Tax Exemption Endorsement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa International Finance Authority
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, SIFA registers the company in the International Companies Register, issues the Certificate of Incorporation, and records the tax-exempt status of the International Company; verify the company name, registered office, share capital, and officers against the certificate.
required_dossiers: Company profile checklist prepared by the registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains a typographical or legal defect, request a certified correction in writing from the Registrar; any substantive change to name or registered office requires a board resolution and an amendment filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparatory Board Meeting and Registrar Notification of Officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the first board meeting to allot shares, fix the registered office, appoint the director and company secretary, approve the opening of bank accounts, and authorize the customs bonded trucking license application; execute the pro-forma first board resolution; file the Notice of Appointment of Directors and Secretary with SIFA within 14 days.
required_dossiers: Minutes of the first board meeting
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Form 7 filing is late or defective, file a corrective notice together with any late filing penalty requested by the Registrar; SIFA may issue a no-objection confirmation of the officer appointments.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Corporate Access and Commencement Readiness
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Issue share certificates, open a corporate bank account with ACH Direct and Bank Wire payment rails, adopt a common seal if required by the articles, obtain certified copies of the incorporation documents, and compile the dossier for industrial and customs licensing.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If banking or counter-party verification fails, obtain an apostille of the Certificate of Incorporation and certified English translations from the competent justice authority; reconcile any mismatch between the certificate and the SIFA register.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Samoa Customs Service and Samoa Land Transport Authority (within the Ministry of Works, Transport and Infrastructure)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Customs Bonded Carrier Licence for International Airport Road Feeder Trucking Operations

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE) - Planning and Urban Management Agency (PUMA)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B - EIA Registration and Permitted Activity Screening; a full EIA Report is not mandatory unless the project includes a depot exceeding 1,000 m2, bulk fuel storage, or operations in a sensitive environmental zone.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Truck wash wastewater must be treated by an oil/grease trap with oil content below 10 ppm before municipal sewer discharge; VOC emissions from fuel storage must remain below 50 mg/Nm3; spent oil, filters, and contaminated absorbents must be handled by MNRE-approved contractors; uncontrolled discharge is prohibited under the Environment Act 2003 (Samoa).

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire and Emergency Services Authority (FESA) fire safety certificate for the depot and vehicle maintenance area; Ministry of Works structural approval for the depot, wash bay, and overhead shelter; Samoa Occupational Safety and Health Service workplace clearance for staff operations and material handling; roadworthiness certification for each bonded truck; and a dangerous goods endorsement if the fleet transports fuel or hazardous cargo.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry for Revenue of Samoa (Mafu o Tupe Lafi), P.O. Box 1874, Apia, Samoa; unified tax and customs administration; official e-services portal: https://www.revenue.gov.ws (TIN issuance, VAGST registration and filing) and ASYCUDA World customs clearance portal for all import/export declarations.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Incorporate the International Company under the International Companies Act 1987 with the Registrar of International Companies (Samoa International Finance Authority / Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour) to obtain the Certificate of Incorporation; no minimum paid-up capital is required for the WS_IC. Step 2: Apply to the Ministry for Revenue for a Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) on the prescribed TIN application form, submitting the certificate of incorporation, registered office instrument, register of directors and shareholders, and (if applicable) the customs bonded transport licence application reference for the road feeder truck fleet. Step 3: The Ministry for Revenue issues a single TIN that serves simultaneously as the VAGST registration account and the customs importer/exporter code for ASYCUDA World; the fleet must also obtain a customs bonded carrier code and a vehicle-registration-linked bond guarantee for each truck. Step 4: The WS_IC is recorded in the tax system under the Tax_Exempt_Zone classification with a nil national income-tax rate file, given its International Company status and non-resident ownership. Step 5: The registered agent must keep the TIN file current and notify the Ministry for Revenue of any change of registered office, director, or agent within 14 days; annual confirmation filings are required.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone: The WS_IC, as a Samoa International Company, is deemed non-resident for income tax purposes and is exempt from Samoan income tax and stamp duty on all foreign-source income; the effective corporate income tax rate is 0%. Samoan-source turnover from bonded airport feeder trucking is excluded from income tax where the transport billing is structured offshore with the international carrier, but the VAGST treatment of the domestic road feeder leg must be independently determined under the indirect tax rules (standard-rated 15% unless zero-rated as an integral component of international carriage of goods).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Samoa does not operate a check-the-box entity classification regime. Available elections: (i) election at incorporation to assume 'International Company' status under the International Companies Act 1987, which is irrevocable without Ministerial consent; (ii) voluntary VAGST registration for a person whose taxable supplies fall below the compulsory turnover threshold; (iii) application by related registered persons to be treated as a single group for VAGST purposes with consolidated returns, subject to Ministry for Revenue approval; (iv) no hybrid mismatch or BEPS entity-equity elections are enacted; residence and place-of-supply determinations follow the Goods and Services Tax Act 2012 and the Income Tax Act 2012.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Goods and Services Tax (VAGST) under the Goods and Services Tax Act 2012 (as amended), administered by the Ministry for Revenue; complemented by the Customs Act (as amended) for bonded movement controls.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: WST 40,000 (Samoan Tala) annual value of taxable supplies in any rolling 12-month period. The GPS-sealed bonded truck fleet operator is mandatorily registrable because the combined domestic airport feeder and export-related transport turnover will exceed WST 40,000 per annum; voluntary registration below the threshold is available and advisable to recover input VAGST on fleet and maintenance costs.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, API stamping, or government digital invoicing mandate is currently in force in Samoa. Tax invoices must contain the prescribed particulars under the Goods and Services Tax Act 2012, must be issued at the time of supply, and must be retained for the statutory record-keeping period. VAGST returns are filed electronically through the Ministry for Revenue eServices portal. For export cargo, ASYCUDA World requires an electronic export declaration and digital goods release; the bonded truck fleet must additionally maintain a GPS-sealed electronic movement record linking the airport customs control area to the bonded terminal, together with a truck manifest certified by Customs, and no cargo movement is legally cleared without that digital trail.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A 0% VAGST rate applies to: (i) goods physically exported from Samoa within 28 days of supply; (ii) international transport of goods or passengers; and (iii) ancillary bonded road feeder services supplied directly in connection with the international carriage of cargo, including the airport feeder leg, provided the WS_IC contracts with the international airline, ocean carrier, or licensed customs agent, the service is performed exclusively between the customs control area of the international airport and a customs bonded terminal, and the supply is properly documented as part of the international consignment chain. Merely domestic warehouse-to-warehouse cartage or courier distribution within Samoa remains standard-rated at 15% and does not qualify for zero-rating.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (ASYCUDA World electronic export entry)
Master Bill of Lading or Master Air Waybill evidencing international carriage
House waybill and bonded truck manifest with GPS-seal log
Inward Remittance Certificate from a licensed Samoan commercial bank evidencing receipt of the foreign transport consideration
Bonded transport licence and customs-approved truck registration documentation
Signed service agreement between the WS_IC and the airline, ocean carrier, or customs bonded warehouse licensee
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Commissioner of the Ministry for Revenue may audit export zero-rating claims retrospectively within the statutory limitation period. If any documentary requirement is missing or the foreign-currency consideration is not repatriated to Samoa within 180 days, the zero-rating is reversed and VAGST becomes payable at 15% on the full supply value, with monthly interest and an administrative shortfall penalty of up to 200% of the avoided tax. Fraudulent or reckless claims additionally trigger forfeiture of the customs security bond, suspension or revocation of the bonded truck fleet licence, director disqualification, and criminal prosecution of the company and its officers under the Tax Administration Act and the Customs Act, with penalties including substantial fines and terms of imprisonment.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (CBS), administering the Exchange Control Act 1930 (Samoa), the Exchange Control Regulations 1952, and CBS foreign-exchange directives; licensing of banks is separately administered by the CBS under the Financial Institutions Act 1996.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Samoan Tala (WST) is not freely convertible offshore; CBS maintains a managed float and requires all WST transactions to be routed through licensed domestic commercial banks. Current-account payments (freight, transit fees, fuel, maintenance) are generally approved with documentary support, while capital-account flows (equity injection, loan repatriation, dividend/redemption remittance) require CBS case-by-case authorization and cumulative threshold reporting. The International Company (IC) is classified as a non-resident offshore entity, which exempts it from certain domestic capital controls, but the licensed bank must still evidence underlying economic substance and the authorised purpose of every transfer.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under Section 18 of the Exchange Control Act and CBS directives, export proceeds must be repatriated to Samoa within six months of shipment, with 100% mandatory conversion into WST unless a CBS-approved foreign-currency retention account is granted. A customs-bonded truck fleet earning USD freight under transhipment contracts may apply for a CBS retention approval to preserve working capital in USD; otherwise all export-related receipts must be surrendered within the statutory period, with the underlying invoice, customs export declaration, signed B/L or CMR, and proof of delivery required for verification by the settling bank.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: The National Bank of Samoa Limited (NBS)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low feasibility. Samoa operates no electronic-money-institution (EMI) licensing framework, and CBS has not issued any regulated digital-banking licence to offshore EMIs. Offshore digital payment providers cannot access Samoa's local settlement systems and would require a sponsorship agreement with a licensed domestic bank plus CBS non-objection, which is highly unlikely under current APG mutual-evaluation scrutiny. The treasury design therefore relies on licensed Samoan commercial banks as the primary account and clearing ledger.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: CBS AML/CFT rules and tier-1 bank policies require at least one natural-person director or senior officer with signatory authority to complete a face-to-face interview, which may be conducted physically at the bank's Apia headquarters or via a recorded videoconference recognised as equivalent. Fully remote opening without any interview is not accepted. For the capital-escrow structure, a notarised Certificate of Incumbency, board resolution designating authorised signatories, and individual interviews for every 25%-or-greater beneficial owner are mandatory.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore-jurisdiction tax-haven profile of the Samoa International Company lacking visible economic substance
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Current IC Registry Certificate of Good Standing; updated beneficial-ownership (BO) register extract under the International Companies Act; audited financial statements; evidence of commercial premises or bonded-warehouse/garage lease in Samoa or a credible third-party service-provider address; employment records for fleet drivers and operations staff; and a written economic-substance roadmap aligned with the Samoan international-company substance regulations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Bearer-share legacy and historical corporate-opacity concerns
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Legal-counsel statutory declaration confirming all issued shares are registered under the International Companies Act Amendment 2017; cancellation certificate evidencing retirement of any prior bearer shares; registered share register; full shareholder schedule with proportionate holdings; and corporate-charter extracts demonstrating mandatory registered offices and records in Samoa.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear source of funds for inbound capital injection and fleet acquisition
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Board-approved capital plan; opening wire confirmations and six months of bank statements from the remitting entity; notarised sale-and-purchase agreements for the bonded truck fleet; independent asset valuation; and a source-of-wealth letter with supporting turnover and profit documentation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: PEP or otherwise high-risk profile detected in the beneficial-ownership or signatory chain
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Completed PEP screening report (Refinitiv/Wolfsberg-aligned); source-of-wealth dossier including certified tax records and professional references; transaction-activity narrative explaining the commercial purpose of the trucking operations; and confirmation of compliance with the Samoan Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All inbound equity injections should be routed via SWIFT telegraphic transfer into a designated USD/WST operational account at BSP Samoa or ANZ Samoa under the CBS-approved purpose code for non-resident IC capital contribution, accompanied by the board resolution, IC Registry extract, and source-of-funds verification package. Transfers exceeding 20,000 WST or USD 100,000 trigger the bank's foreign-exchange reporting obligation; the drawdown schedule and escrow release must match the approved capital plan to avoid correspondent-bank flagging by BSP's Westpac nostro or ANZ's international network.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For bonded-truck trade settlements, use SWIFT MT103 for freight payments, transit handling charges, agent commissions, and fuel disbursements, each supported by the CMR, waybill, or service invoice; equipment and high-value fleet purchases should be settled by commercial letter of credit under UCP 600, with the Samoan commercial bank acting as issuing or advising bank only after CBS authorisation of the relevant FX. Foreign-currency disbursements above the 20,000 WST threshold require a CBS-approved Form FX-1, while pure offshore-to-offshore USD settlements may be executed directly through the IC foreign-currency ledger without WST conversion.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: CBS-approved USD/WST outright forwards with tenor of three to six months for confirmed trade flows
Offshore Samoa Tala non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) executed through correspondent banks where physical WST delivery is constrained
Cross-currency swaps with licensed Samoan commercial banks to align monthly USD fuel and CAPEX obligations against USD freight revenue
Natural hedging via a dual-currency treasury pool maintaining matched USD assets and liabilities to minimise forced WST conversion

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: International Company Annual Renewal and Registered Agent Compliance Certificate
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Government of Samoa
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the anniversary date of incorporation each year; renewal notice issued by registered agent at least 30 days prior.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late penalty of 10% per month on the unpaid annual fee; continued non-payment beyond 90 days after the anniversary triggers administrative strike-off and vesting of all assets in the Samoa Government.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Customs Bonded Truck Operator Annual Licence Renewal with Surety Bond Revalidation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Samoa Revenue and Customs Authority (Customs and Excise Division)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 December each year; renew with vehicle fleet schedule, driver identification records, GPS telemetry certification, and customs bond guarantee for bonded goods in transit.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Lapse of licence automatically suspends all bonded cargo movement rights; each unauthorized movement attracts a fine of WST 2,000 (~USD 750) per load; persistent violation leads to immediate strike-off from the bonded transport registry and criminal prosecution under the Customs Act 2014.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership Confirmation and Shareholding Update Return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Samoa International Companies Registrar (Financial Intelligence Unit Reporting Window)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 21 days after the anniversary of incorporation; all share transfers during the year must be recorded in the company’s register within 14 days and attached to this return.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-filing or false filing is an offence under the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2021; penalties up to WST 10,000 (~USD 3,500) for the company plus WST 2,000 (~USD 700) per individual officer; continuous default may lead to registration cancellation.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No mandatory statutory audit for an International Company incorporated under the International Companies Act 1987, provided the company does not hold bonded cargo on behalf of third parties exceeding USD 100,000 in aggregate customs value at any time; a limited independent verification of the customs surety bond and vehicle GPS register is triggered above this threshold or upon written direction from the Registrar or Samoa Customs.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted by Samoa (International Financial Reporting Standards) for all internally prepared or externally produced financial statements; simplified disclosure is permitted for qualified non-public entities.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The registered agent must conduct a calendar-year verification of all beneficial owners and prompt any shareholder of record to confirm the same; any share transfer occurring during the year must be logged in the Register of Members within 14 days and must be included in the annual UBO confirmation submitted to the Registrar within 21 days of the anniversary. Failure to maintain an accurate UBO register is a separate continuing offence with a fine of WST 5,000 (~USD 1,700) per month.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: International Companies (IC) are exempt from Samoa income tax on foreign-sourced income and certain domestic-source income as provided under the International Companies Act 1987 and Income Tax Act 2012; no withholding tax on distributions to non-residents; no capital gains tax; no estate or gift tax.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Samoa International Companies do not file a corporate income tax return for exempt income; annual declaration of compliance filed with the Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) via authorized registered agent. If domestic taxable income exists, Form IRD Tax Return (Company) is filed through the Ministry for Revenue Online Services.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Annual Declaration and licence renewal: no later than 31 January following the tax year; corporate income tax return (if applicable): within 6 months after the end of the accounting period (e.g., 30 June for 31 December year-end).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name and IC registration number.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter as per Certificate of Incorporation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Annual Declaration – Registered office and agent details
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Samoa-registered office address and licensed agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Maintain a registered agent in Samoa; foreign address not accepted.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Annual Declaration – Declaration of no taxable domestic activity
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirm the company has not engaged in domestic Samoa-source business.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If conducting domestic activity, a corporate tax return may be required.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Form IRD Corporate Return – Gross income
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total Samoa-source income subject to tax.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report only income sourced in Samoa; offshore income excluded.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Expenses incurred in deriving Samoa-source taxable income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Allocate expenses on an arm's length basis; substantiate with invoices.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Form IRD Corporate Return – Tax payable
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If fully exempt, enter zero and attach exemption evidence.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late annual declaration: penalty of WST 500 plus WST 50 per month. Late tax return: 5% of unpaid tax (minimum WST 100) plus 5% for each month or part month, capped at 25%. Knowingly providing false declarations: fine up to WST 10,000 and/or imprisonment for up to 5 years.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% (exempt for International Companies; no dividend withholding tax on distributions to non-residents)
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Samoa's double taxation agreements (e.g., with New Zealand, Australia) provide reduced rates. Protocol: (1) Obtain a Certificate of Residence from the Samoa Ministry for Revenue (or SIFA for ICs) confirming tax-resident status; (2) Submit the certificate and a treaty relief claim form to the payor or tax authority in the source jurisdiction; (3) Payor applies reduced rate subject to beneficial ownership test; Samoa ICs generally qualify as residents under the tie-breaker if managed and controlled in Samoa.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory domestic rate: 15% on interest and royalties paid by Samoa-resident companies to non-residents. Treaty rates: e.g., New Zealand/DTA – interest 10%, royalties 10%; not applicable to exempt ICs making offshore payments. ICs are not subject to withholding on foreign-sourced royalty/interest paid out.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: There is no explicit Samoa statutory TP documentation threshold for International Companies; TP rules apply to persons with associated enterprises engaging in cross-border controlled transactions. The Samoa Income Tax Act 2012 incorporates the OECD arm's length principle. Documentation is recommended where aggregate related-party turnover exceeds WST 500,000 or where cross-border intercompany transactions exceed WST 1 million.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Samoa is a non-harmful jurisdiction within the OECD Forum; International Companies must demonstrate economic substance if conducting international business. The Customs Bonded Truck Fleet activity requires: (1) physical presence in Samoa – licensed warehouse/garage or contractual access, (2) full-time employees in Samoa managing logistics and fleet, (3) real assets – bonded trucks registered in Samoa or regional fleet management, (4) actual airport feeder operations generating core income. Shell companies with no substance are liable to penalty of WST 100,000 or revocation of licence.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate understatement of Samoa-source income or making false declarations in the annual declaration / tax return.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fine of up to WST 50,000 and/or imprisonment for up to 7 years (Income Tax Act 2012); civil penalty of 100% of tax evaded.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be jointly and severally liable for civil restitution of evaded tax; travel bans issued for outstanding assessments; imprisonment up to 7 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating as a registered International Company without any real presence, employees, or physical assets while claiming tax exemption; engaging in repeated nominee-only arrangements.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Immediate revocation of IC status; fine up to WST 100,000; automatic termination of tax exemption; directors disqualification for 10 years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors personally liable for unpaid taxes of the company (up to 3 years of tax); personal restitutions orders; cross-border asset freezing.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the bonded truck fleet to move goods subject to customs or sanctions without proper clearance; failure to implement adequate AML/KYC controls for cargo clients under the Samoa AML/CFT Act 2018.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal fines up to WST 2 million for corporate entity; licence revocation; asset forfeiture under Proceeds of Crime Act; anti-money laundering compliance orders.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors fined up to WST 100,000 and imprisonment for up to 14 years for willful blindness; personal travel bans; prohibition from holding directorship in any Samoa company.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Engaging in cross-border related-party transactions (e.g., fleet lease or management fees to a foreign affiliate) without preparing contemporaneous TP documentation or applying arm's length pricing.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: TP adjustment to taxable income; penalty of 50% of additional tax liability; late documentation penalty of WST 5,000 per month.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors personally liable where they signed false declarations; pecuniary penalties up to WST 10,000; disqualification for 5 years.
